IN THIS GUIDE

LifespanDiet & nutritionPersonalityHousing & enrichmentNoiseThe right match

Examples include: Umbrella, sulphur-crested and Moluccan cockatoos; galahs.

01

Lifespan & long-term planning

Lifespan differs markedly between cockatoo species. Published averages and longevity records are not the same thing. These birds require a multi-decade care plan rather than reliance on a single maximum age.

02

Diet & nutrition

A balanced feeding plan should include suitable formulated food and fresh produce. Keep energy-rich treats measured and review weight and diet with an avian vet.

03

Personality & temperament

Often highly expressive and socially demanding. Build healthy independence with foraging and a steady routine as well as time together.

04

Housing & enrichment

Provide a robust enclosure, safe exercise, appropriate chew materials and regular enrichment. Feather dust is an important consideration when planning the home environment.

05

Noise & vocalisation

Many species have powerful calls. Noise and feather dust can make some homes unsuitable.

06

Is this group right for you?

A well-prepared household that understands the group’s social demands, noise and long-term needs.
